label: Venafro
note: The town. Battery E's station to 16 Jan 1944.

label: Battery E, 67th CA (AA), Lucenteforte
source: Battery E morning reports; the place as printed on sheet 161-III
note: The battery's station, 17 Jan - 26 Feb 1944, placed at the place name on the map (army/places.csv); the gun positions are not given.

label: Battery E, sections 2, 4, 6 and 8, "vicinity of St. Elia"
source: Battery E morning report, record of events 24 Feb 1944
note: Half the battery's guns, 10-23 Feb, "in position" in the vicinity of St. Elia; placed at the town (the circle on the town on the Feb 1944 Bezugspunktkarte, t312-0090/f0215). Before that at Casale (from 15 Jan) and Acquafondata (from 24 Jan).

label: Battery H, 67th CA (AA), "near Aquafondata"
note: "Btry CP moved up with guns near Aquafondata": placed at the village (army/places.csv); the gun positions are not given. 12 Feb - 10 Mar 1944.

label: XXIII 97 (Sant'Elia)
source: Bezugspunktkarte, Feb 1944 edition, 8Z 86 (XXIII 97 less 11), decoded with tools/bezugspunkt.py
note: Printed point 86, the circle on S. Elia Fiumerapido. Named in the 5th Mountain Division's reports of 14 and 21 Feb (t314-0544/f0361, f0362, f0486).

label: XXIII 112 (east of Cassino)
source: Bezugspunktkarte, Feb 1944 edition, 8Z 101, decoded with tools/bezugspunkt.py
note: One enemy battery engaged here on 16 Feb (t314-0544/f0406); a 17 cm battery fired on a battery here by sound-ranging in the night 15-16 Feb (f0392).

label: XXIII 117 (Vallerotonda)
source: Bezugspunktkarte, Feb 1944 edition, 8Z 106, decoded with tools/bezugspunkt.py
note: Printed point 106, the circle on Vallerotonda. One enemy battery engaged "bei XXIII 117" on 16 Feb (t314-0544/f0406); harassing fire on XXIII 117 and the supply roads on 21 or 22 Feb (f0486).

label: XXIII 122 (south of Cervaro)
source: Bezugspunktkarte, Feb 1944 edition, 8Z 111, decoded with tools/bezugspunkt.py
note: Two enemy batteries engaged here on 16 Feb (t314-0544/f0406). The point's reading on the map is uncertain (the number sits below-right of its circle).

label: Battery A, 67th CA (AA) (1st Bn), St. Elia
note: A 90 mm battery of the regiment's 1st Battalion, at St. Elia 8-18 Feb 1944, placed at the town (army/places.csv); the gun position is not given. Context: not the 2nd Battalion.
